column9: Separately minted siblings under BFO generically dependent continuant: spo anchors iao:0000030, CCO mints its own subclass of BFO_0000031 that additionally requires generic dependence on an Information Bearing Entity. Not identity -> closeMatch (MC-3).

spo anchors qudt:Unit; CCO seats Measurement Unit under its Descriptive ICE. Same referent (a conventional standard of measurement), different mint and parentage -> closeMatch. spo keeps the QUDT track: the anchor stays qudt:Unit and the CCO term is reached by this mapping row, never by re-anchoring.
Both denote the information item recording a measured extent relative to a standard; spo anchors qudt:QuantityValue. CCO's Ratio Measurement ICE (ont00001022) is a narrower sibling, not mapped here.

CCO has no mathematical-formula ICE; the only defensible statement is adjacency under ICE. Recorded so downstream sees the absence explicitly rather than guessing (ISO/IEC 21838-2 4.9.10 places formulae in IAO's domain).
